segments.zh: 我的意思是，他们有这么多债务。

segments.en: They've produced cars that nobody really wants to buy, and now they're in trouble.
segments.zh: 他们生产了没有人真正想买的汽车，现在他们遇到了麻烦。

segments.en: And it's not our money that should be spent on saving them.
segments.zh: 应该花在拯救他们上的不是我们的钱。

segments.en: Yeah, I would agree with you on that.
segments.zh: 是的，我同意你的看法。

segments.en: But you do have to take into consideration the fact that if these companies go bankrupt, thousands of people will lose their jobs, and not only the people that work at the factories, but also people that work for other companies that supply these factories.
segments.zh: 但你必须考虑到如果这些公司破产，成千上万的人将失去工作，不仅是在工厂工作的人，还有为其他供应这些工厂的公司工作的人。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, I see what you're saying, Marco, but at the same time, we can't support an industry that isn't working properly.
segments.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我明白你在说什么，Marco，但与此同时，我们无法支持一个无法正常工作的行业。

segments.en: I mean, if one of these companies goes bankrupt, it's going to be terrible, but it will force the other two companies, perhaps, to manage themselves better, to streamline and become more efficient.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，如果其中一家公司破产，那将是可怕的，但它可能会迫使其他两家公司更好地管理自己，精简并提高效率。

segments.en: I just think it will be better in the future.
segments.zh: 我只是觉得将来会更好。

segments.en: Well, it could be, but also maybe all three companies can go bankrupt.
segments.zh: 好吧，它可能是，但也许所有三个公司都可能破产。

segments.en: It would be sad because the American car, the American auto industry is a symbol of prosperity.
segments.zh: 可悲的是，因为美国汽车，美国汽车工业是繁荣的象征。

segments.en: It's also the symbol of the American culture in general.
segments.zh: 它也是美国文化的象征。

segments.en: I guess that's true.
segments.zh: 我想这是真的。

segments.en: So it would be a shame for it to go bankrupt because everyone owns a car in the United States, or most people, and it's just something that we can't lose.
segments.zh: 所以破产是一种耻辱，因为每个人在美国或大多数人都有一辆车，而这只是我们不能失去的东西。

segments.en: But it is an interesting topic and we also want to know your opinions about this.
segments.zh: 但这是一个有趣的话题，我们也想知道您对此的看法。

segments.en: Yeah, listeners, please come to our website at EnglishPod.com and tell us what you think about this bailout and about this lesson.
segments.zh: 是的，听众，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com 并告诉我们您对本次救助的看法以及本课。

segments.en: On the website, we'll post a link to the news article where you can read a little bit more about this because this is actually going on now.
segments.zh: 在网站上，我们将发布一个指向新闻文章的链接，您可以在其中阅读更多关于此的信息，因为现在实际上正在进行。

segments.en: That's true.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: Well, everyone, thanks for listening and until next time, goodbye.
segments.zh: 好吧，大家，感谢您的收听，直到下一次，再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
